title: Add enhancements to Business Central demo environments

facts.text: Contoso Coffee Demo Data app adds demo data to showcase advanced manufacturing and supply chain features.
Connectivity apps let you demonstrate integrations and connected scenarios between Business Central and other apps.
Sign up for Dynamics 365 Sales Professional trial using your Microsoft demo account admin credentials.
In Power Platform admin center, install Field Service app to Sales trial environment from Marketplace.
Open Assisted Setup in Business Central and select setup for Dataverse connection first.
Complete Sales integration setup before Field Service setup, as Field Service setup depends on it.
After setup, Business Central, Sales, and Field Service share data through Dataverse for end-to-end scenarios.
Convert trial environments to sandbox environments to reset data and demo different Dynamics 365 app combinations.
